newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSTANT VIEW-Australian wages,company profits data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Australian wages,company profits data.

text.p: Australian average weekly ordinary times earnings (AWOTE) rose 1.0 percent in the three months to February, revised down from a preliminary 1.3 percent reported earlier this month, official data shows.
In annual terms wages growth was 4.3 percent, compared with a preliminary 4.6 percent.
Private sector wages rose 1.3 percent in the quarter to be up 3.6 percent over the year, and public sector wages rose 0.7 percent in the quarter for an annual rate of 7.1 percent.
Separate data showed that company profits data for the March quarter fell 3.4 percent. Forecasts had centred on a 2.0 percent fall.
A selection of economists' immediate reactions to the data follows.
